concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but the dependency table requires T001 → T002 → … → T007. Running T001 in parallel with later tasks would break the required directory hierarchy.

Task T005 (`src/cli/main.py`) is marked `[P]` yet it depends on the directories created by T001/T002, the pinned requirements from T003, and the config file from T006. It cannot be safely executed in parallel with those producers.
Task T013 adds structured logging for `topology_extractor.py` and is marked `[P]`, but it must run after T012 (the extractor) which produces the log file. Parallel execution would miss the log.
Task T014 is an integration test that invokes the extractor; it depends on T012 and therefore cannot be parallel‑safe.
Task T016 (`sensitivity_analyzer.py`) is `[P]` yet it consumes output from T015. It must run after T015.
Task T017 is an integration test for the VDOS calculator and depends on T015; it cannot be parallel‑safe.
Task T020 adds an integration test for the full correlation pipeline and depends on T019; the `[P]` tag is inaccurate.
Task T021 generates a PDF report that incorporates figures produced by T022 and tables from T019. Marking it `[P]` violates producer‑before‑consumer ordering.
Task T022 saves figures that are referenced in T021; it cannot be parallel‑safe.
Task T023 updates the README with a command that runs the full pipeline; it must occur after the pipeline (T021‑T025) is functional.
Task T024 generates API docs that assume the services are already implemented (e.g., T012‑T019). It should not be `[P]`.
Task T025 runs the full test suite and checks coverage; it must be executed after all previous tasks have produced code and artifacts.
Task T027 is a unit test that validates the manual reference correlation; it depends on T026 and therefore cannot be parallel‑safe.
Task T028 extends `statistical_analyzer.py` and must run after T019; the `[P]` tag is incorrect.
Task T029 is an integration test that expects a download failure from the registry; it depends on the registry services (T008‑T009) and cannot be parallel‑safe.
